orders: All six lane orders for baseline, same-path control and tile. Reverse their round order at one worker.
timers: Gate/Up includes SwiGLU and worker joins. Down is measured separately and computes the same projection in every arm. Sum the two stages before forming FFN ratios.

preflight.numerical: Bit equality for the fused output and the Down result; odd tails and disjoint tile ranges under race detection.
preflight.interpretation: Both worker counts must pass for a model timing candidate. This is a synthetic workload, not an inference speed or resident-memory claim.
